PART ONE

CHAPTER I

This is the first chapter of the sample book. It contains some text that will be used for testing the chapter splitting functionality. There are several paragraphs here to make sure everything works correctly.

Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris.

This paragraph has an [Illustration: test image] that should be removed. Also some _italic_ text that needs to be cleaned. And a dash--test that should become a comma.

CHAPTER II

This is the second chapter. It continues the story with more text and different content. The chapter splitting should handle this properly.

Sed ut perspiciatis unde omnis iste natus error sit voluptatem accusantium doloremque laudantium, totam rem aperiam, eaque ipsa quae.

CHAPTER III

The third chapter is here. More content follows below.

Nemo enim ipsam voluptatem quia voluptas sit aspernatur aut odit aut fugit, sed quia consequuntur magni dolores eos qui ratione voluptatem.
